title: Law Harry
html_source: The phrase is in fact “by the Lord Harry” – a blasphemy, made by the juxtaposition of the Lord (Jesus Christ) and Harry (an old term for the Devil) – the uncle is again imagined to be incorrect.

anchor.prefix:
Papa's little bedpal. Lump of love.
